winning_patterns: Imperative 3-word command hooks that demand immediate identity confrontation (e.g., 'REJECT THE TIMELINE') over passive questions
Visceral, high-stakes physical macro visual metaphors (e.g., fracturing black glass with laser intersections) creating instant pattern interruption
Compressed narrative pacing with core argumentation scenes capped at 8 seconds maximum to prevent drop-off
High-friction systems-theory terminology ('deliberate operational friction', 'calculated compliance') paired with single-word high-intent CTA keywords ('PROTOCOL')
deprecated_hooks: Rhetorical question hooks ending in question marks (e.g., 'TRADING AGENCY FOR COMFORT?')
Cliche temporal visuals like backward-ticking analog clocks or static silhouettes gazing into abysses
Extended single-scene middle segments exceeding 8 seconds without visual state changes
hook_modifier: Force all hooks to be 2-4 word uppercase imperative commands or provocative declarations. Never use rhetorical questions or question marks. Frame the opening line as an immediate systemic disruption that challenges standard compliance and implies an urgent operational shift.
visual_style_modifier: Enforce high-contrast 9:16 macro cinematography centered on dynamic physical destruction or kinetic micro-events (e.g., fracturing glass, directional high-intensity lasers, particulate collisions) rendered in dark charcoal (#121212) with razor-sharp gold or electric blue accents. Strictly limit individual scene durations to a maximum of 8 seconds with mandatory motion-blur transitions or visual state shifts at the midpoint.
